gitCommit.subject: fix(site): the commission is typed per exchange and paid by the customer (D164)
gitCommit.body:
fix(site): the commission is typed per exchange and paid by the customer (D164)

The Dukan ERP page said the commission is recorded from a rate the Owner configures per provider. The owner's rule (2026-10-12): no rate; the employee types the commission for every exchange; the customer pays it; it is the business's revenue, never paid or checked by the provider and never changes the provider credit; the employee is taken from the sign-in. EN/FR/AR, and a content test refuses the rate claim in any language.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
